purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - monthly treatment-act-by-act billing summary report (診療行為別月計表)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It generates a monthly summary report of medical treatments by act/category (診療行為別月計表), reading patient, insurance, accounting, and treatment master data via numerous COPY-included record layouts and producing printed output. It handles inpatient/outpatient distinctions, room-charge differentials, and various insurance combinations.

notable_features: 40 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSRYACCT, CPPTINF, CPTENSU, etc.)
111 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram library
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses MCPSUB DB access layer
High comment ratio (39%) with Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments
Revision history spanning 2003-2009 with named developers
REPLACING clause on COPY for record-layout reuse
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (garbled in latin-1 view). Source is truncated to 16000 chars of 148966 bytes total. The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing platform; dialect is effectively GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations - likely uses binary or display numerics throughout.
